thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: sustained spike in 429s on /v1/completions (frontend-proxy). Alert rule: 429_rate > 300/m over 5m. Auto-paged oncall.
maria (oncall): I'm on it. Observed dashboards show 429s ramped ~50/m -> ~1.2k/m over 10m. 503s also ticked up to ~1.8% on inference fleet.
paul (support): FYI customer tickets report degraded completions for a few enterprise tenants. No data exfil concerns yet.
jonah (runtime): linking grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/traffic/429-503-trends?orgId=1 :chart_with_upwards_trend:
carla (sre): can you paste the top-ten tenants by 429s? need to see if this is noisy multi-tenant or a single noisy tenant.
maria (oncall): quick query from logs (raw counts):
```
topk(10, sum by(tenant) (increase(http_response_status{status=429}[10m])))
```
results: acme-inc: 720, unknown-b2b: 210, beta-userpool: 90, others <50. acme-inc is ~60% of recent 429s.
jonah (runtime): acme-inc has a recent campaign that increases short-sequence completions. That can overload prefix cache + qps.
carla (sre): plan: 1) apply tenant QPS cap for acme-inc 2) disable streaming for public endpoints 3) enable aggressive KV cache warmup & reduce batch window. Do them in that order?
maria (oncall): Agreed. I'll do caps first. Executing admin action:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://admin.redwood.internal/tenants/acme-inc/rate_limit -d '{"qps":30, "burst":60, "reason":"emergency-shape-429-2026-03-14"}'
```
deploy-bot: scheduled action queued: tenant-rate-limit-update(acme-inc) id=rt-20260314-01
maria (oncall): applied. API returned 200.
carla (sre): confirm counters after 60s.
maria (oncall): after 90s: cluster 429 total -> 520/m (was 1.2k). acme-inc 429s dropped to 140. 503s remain ~1.6% (slight improvement).
jonah (runtime): good. Next: disable streaming for public completions (reduces long-lived connections and KV pressure). Command:
```
PATCH /service/config
{"feature_flags":{"streaming_public_completions":false}}
```
maria (oncall): applied flag via console. deploy-bot: rollout started for flag streaming_public_completions -> false across region-us-east.
deploy-bot: flag rollout: 20% -> 100% (in 3 batches)
paul (support): notified account execs for acme-inc and said we're throttling to 30qps while we stabilize.
carla (sre): watch 429s, 5xx rate, tail latency and queue depth. Query I'm watching:
```
rate(http_requests_total{status=429}[1m])
rate(http_requests_total{status=503}[1m])
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[1m])) by (le))
```
maria (oncall): 10m after caps & streaming off: cluster 429s -> 220/m, 503s -> 0.9%, p99 inference latency down ~180ms -> 140ms.
jonah (runtime): looks like primary win was the tenant cap. Streaming disable helped p99. We should consider a temporary model-fallback for heavy tenants: fall back to smaller quantized variant to keep throughput.
carla (sre): +1 on fallback, but that's heavier config. For now, keep shape and observe for 30m. If we see 503s creep back or tail latency > 250ms, do fallback.
maria (oncall): setting incident status: mitigation in place (tenant cap + streaming disabled). ETA to handoff: 30m. Adding note to status page: "Partial degradation for heavy tenants; temporary throttling to preserve availability."
paul (support): I'll keep ACME PM & support looped. Any customer-facing SLA hits? looks like some API calls are being rate-limited but not full outages.
carla (sre): estimate impacted requests: ~2.4% of total requests hitting 429s after mitigation; before mitigation it was ~8.7%.
maria (oncall): starting monitoring window. Will escalate to fallback if 429 > 400/m cluster-wide or 503 > 1.5% sustained.
jonah (runtime): I'll prep a model-fallback playbook and a quick toggle for acme-inc to move to model-small-1.encoded if needed.
maria (oncall): 20m check: 429s stable ~190/m, 503s 0.7%, no significant error budget burn. Lowering paging noise.
carla (sre): I'm taking the next 30m shift for active monitoring and will handle escalation if thresholds cross. maria, can you write a short handoff note?
maria (oncall): handoff: "Active mitigation: tenant qps cap 30 (acme-inc), streaming_public_completions disabled globally, monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/traffic/429-503-trends. Escalation thresholds: 429 > 400/m OR 503 > 1.5% sustained 5m -> fallback to model-small-1.encoded for top offenders or open further throttles. Contact oncall channel for direct page."
carla (sre): taking over. thanks. :thumbsup:
paul (support): closing interim customer-facing note: "We applied temporary rate limiting for some heavy usage to protect overall service. Your team can request capacity increase via support if needed."
jonah (runtime): follow-up: will schedule a non-urgent postmortem to look at cache warming & tenant-specific routing to avoid future single-tenant amplifications.
maria (oncall): leaving thread. thanks all. :wave:
carla (sre): ack, monitoring. will update if anything changes.
